name: EyeToyPSVita
description: PS Vita / PS TV homebrew: camera motion detection engine + working PlayStation Move controller driver (SceBt kernel plugin, Bluetooth HID pairing, sensor decoding)
long_description: A taiHEN kernel plugin driving a **PS Move controller over `SceBt`**. Bluetooth pairing, HID connection and full sensor decoding (accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer, buttons, sphere colour, rumble) work and are verified on real hardware. The **factory calibration blob** (feature report `0x10`) is decoded too, so the controller reports real **g** and **°/s**.
